SELECT skill_version FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'SKILL_DEF' AND skill_code = #{skill} AND lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task( record_type, skill_code, prompt_version, prompt_template, model_config, is_current, lifecycle_status, approval_status, content_sha256, release_notes, published_at, approved_at, rollout_percent, skill_version_snapshot, created_by ) VALUES ( 'PROMPT_VERSION', #{row.skillCode}, #{row.promptVersion}, #{row.promptTemplate}, CAST(#{row.modelConfig} AS JSON), #{row.isCurrent}, #{row.lifecycleStatus}, #{row.approvalStatus}, #{row.contentSha256}, #{row.releaseNotes}, IF(#{row.bootstrap} AND #{row.isCurrent}, NOW(3), NULL), IF(#{row.bootstrap} AND #{row.isCurrent}, NOW(3), NULL), IF(#{row.isCurrent}, 100, 0), #{row.skillVersionSnapshot}, #{row.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET prompt_template = #{template}, model_config = CAST(#{model} AS JSON), content_sha256 = #{sha}, release_notes = 'Git manifest baseline', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'PROMPT_VERSION'
mapper.select: SELECT skill_code FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'PROMPT_VERSION' AND is_current = TRUE AND lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND emergency_disabled = FALSE
SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'SKILL_DEF' ORDER BY skill_code, created_at DESC
SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'PROMPT_VERSION' AND skill_code = #{skill} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

WITH base AS ( SELECT prompt_version, task_status, COALESCE( latency_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, created_at, COALESCE(completed_at, updated_at)) / 1000 ) AS latency_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd FROM t_ai_task WHERE skill_code = #{skill} AND record_type IN ('INVOCATION', 'ASSISTANT_QUERY') AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ), ranked AS ( SELECT base.prompt_version, base.task_status, base.latency_ms, base.input_tokens, base.output_tokens, base.estimated_cost_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_version ORDER BY latency_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_version) AS version_count FROM base ) SELECT prompt_version, COUNT(*) AS invocation_count, SUM(task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'SUCCEEDED')) AS success_count, SUM(task_status IN ('FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING')) AS failure_count, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(version_count * 0.50) THEN latency_ms END) AS p50_latency_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(version_count * 0.95) THEN latency_ms END) AS p95_latency_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(version_count * 0.99) THEN latency_ms END) AS p99_latency_ms, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, ROUND(SUM(estimated_cost_usd), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM ranked GROUP BY prompt_version ORDER BY invocation_count DESC

UPDATE t_ai_task SET is_current = FALSE, lifecycle_status = 'RETIRED', retired_at = NOW(3), updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE record_type = 'SKILL_DEF' AND skill_code = #{skill} AND is_current = TRUE

UPDATE t_ai_task SET is_current = TRUE, lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{actor}, published_at = NOW(3), retired_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'SKILL_DEF'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET is_current = TRUE, lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{actor}, published_at = NOW(3), retired_at = NULL, previous_prompt_version_id = #{previous}, rollout_percent = IF(#{previous} IS NULL, 100, 0), shadow_percent = 0, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'PROMPT_VERSION'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET is_current = FALSE, lifecycle_status = 'RETIRED', emergency_disabled = TRUE, retired_at = NOW(3), release_notes = LEFT(CONCAT(COALESCE(release_notes, ''), ' | emergency:', #{reason}), 500) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'PROMPT_VERSION'
